decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the firm's core handcrafted Christmas offer and once prominently promoted, management is likely to continue it rather than concede that the recent investment was misplaced.
This product is a simple extension of the traditional pyramid range, so in a still favorable market it is easy for management to justify keeping it for another season.
Although it fits the craft tradition less well and related add-ons were already cut, its flagship status and the firm's visible commitment still make management prone to persist for now.
Because this themed pyramid builds directly on the established seasonal assortment, the sunk design effort and strong strategic fit support retaining it.
